description_en: Queries the detailed logs of attack traffic. Each log entry contains the details of a request that matched a protection rule
description_zh: 查询攻击流量的详情日志列表，每条日志中包含了一条请求命中的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-security-event-logs --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --filter '{"DateRange":{},"Conditions":[{}]}' --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSecurityEventLogs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The name of the field to filter. This operation supports all fields
fields.help_zh: 执行过滤操作的字段名称，该接口支持所有字段
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: A list of filter conditions. Each node describes a filter condition
fields.help_zh: 过滤条件列表，每一个节点描述一个过滤条件
fields.name: conditions

fields.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 查询数据时使用的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
fields.name: end_date

fields.help_en:
The start of the time range to query. The time range cannot exceed the last 30 days. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

The start time must be within the last 30 days from the current time
fields.help_zh:
查询的数据范围不超过过去30天。查询数据时使用的开始时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。


开始时间必须晚于当前时间减去30天。
-
fields.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The filter conditions. A logical AND relationship exists between multiple filter conditions
parameters.help_zh: 查询过滤条件，多个过滤条件之间是逻辑与的关系
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to return for a paged query. The default value is 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

schema.description_zh: 返回的数据结果，格式样例参见示例

SecurityEventLogs.description_zh: 返回的攻击日志详情列表

SecurityEventLogsTotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的攻击日志总条数

DateRange.description_zh: 查询时使用的时间范围

EndDate.description_zh: 查询数据时使用的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。该值和入参数重的EndDate一致
